description: Anonymous BEGIN...END blocks: DECLARE DEFAULT/:=, typed declaration reading an earlier untyped one, RETURN of integers/strings/expressions/variables/NULL, cursor-built ARRAY and OBJECT returns, RETURN TABLE(resultset) via EXECUTE IMMEDIATE, transactions with ROLLBACK inside a block, per-statement clock reads, and plain SQL column references inside a procedure body escaping the block name check. Converted 1:1 from scripting/BeginEndDeclareTest, BeginEndReturnTest, BlockStatementClockTest and PlainSqlInBlockScopeTest (all now retired).

steps.sql: DECLARE x INTEGER DEFAULT 1; BEGIN x := 2; END;
CREATE TABLE customers (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR)
CREATE TABLE qa (row_id INT, src VARIANT)

CREATE PROCEDURE p() RETURNS STRING LANGUAGE SQL EXECUTE AS CALLER AS $$
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO qa (ROW_ID, SRC)
    SELECT ROW_ID, {} AS SRC FROM qa WHERE FALSE UNION ALL
    SELECT 1, {} AS SRC;
    RETURN 'ok';
END
$$
